newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto golds gain on stronger bullion price.
newsitem.headline: Toronto golds gain on stronger bullion price.

text.p: Gold stocks on the Toronto Stock Exchange gleamed on Friday morning, pushed up by a stronger gold bullion price.
Gold fixed at $382.80 an ounce in London, up from $381.80.

The metal has been under pressure recently as an IMF meeting on possible gold reserve sales creeps closer. The IMF has proposed selling five million ounces of its 104 million of reserves to finance debt relief for poor countries.
The gold index on the Toronto Stock Exchange was up 1.21 percent in early trading Friday. Barrick Gold Corp was up C$0.45 to C$36.85 and Placer Dome Inc rose C$0.55 to C$33.
Teck Corp gained C$0.15 to C$27.80 and TVX Gold Inc was up C$0.20 to C$10.50.
But Band-Ore Resources Ltd bucked the trend, falling C$0.95 to C$12.30 after making big gains on Thursday.

The exploration company has been heavily traded and volatile since it was listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange on Tuesday. The company's exploration property in Timmins, Ontario has attracted attention recently at a trade show.
